sections.title: Public sector banks: headquarters, taglines and year

blocks.text: As per the 2024-25 syllabus list, there are **12 public sector banks**. Exams love asking where each one sits and what its tagline says, so learn the whole table below as one unit.

blocks.title: The 12 public sector banks: bank, headquarters, tagline, year
rows: The Nation banks on us; Pure Banking nothing else; With you all the way
The Name you can Bank Upon
Build A Better Life Around Us; Central to you since 1911
Taking Banking Technology to Common Man; Your Tech-friendly bank
Where service is a way of life

blocks.title: Check the year column before trusting any list
blocks.text: Some printed lists show 1910 for Canara Bank and 1840 for Bank of Maharashtra. Canara Bank was founded in 1906 at Mangalore, and Bank of Maharashtra in 1935 at Pune. PNB is usually dated from 1894, when it was incorporated, with business starting in 1895.

blocks.title: Mumbai has four of the twelve
blocks.phrase: Mumbai’s SBI Bank Central Union: State Bank, Bank of India, Central Bank, Union Bank all sit in Mumbai.
blocks.note: Four of the twelve PSBs are in Mumbai, which is more than any other city.

blocks.title: Pairs that share a city
blocks.phrase: The two Punjab banks live in Delhi; the two Indian banks live in Chennai.
letters: Both in New Delhi (both start with Punjab)
Both in Chennai (both start with Indian)
blocks.note: Single cities: Baroda sits in Vadodara, Maharashtra in Pune, Canara in Bengaluru, UCO in Kolkata.

sections.title: Public sector banks grouped by headquarters city

blocks.title: City to banks
rows: State Bank of India, Bank of India, Central Bank of India, Union Bank of India
Punjab National Bank, Punjab & Sind Bank

blocks.title: Two traps
blocks.text: Bank of Baroda is headquartered in Vadodara, not Baroda and not Mumbai. Bank of Maharashtra is in Pune, not Mumbai.

blocks.title: One bank, one city
blocks.phrase: Baroda → Vadodara (same state, old name); Maharashtra → Pune; Canara → Bengaluru; UCO → Kolkata (the ‘Calcutta’ bank).
blocks.note: UCO is short for United Commercial Bank, and it is the one with its head office in the east, at Kolkata.

blocks.title: Taglines by bank
rows: The Nation banks on us; Pure Banking nothing else; With you all the way
The Name you can Bank Upon
Relationship beyond Banking (its logo carries a star)
One Family One Bank (Ek Parivar Ek Bank)
Build A Better Life Around Us; Central to you since 1911
Taking Banking Technology to Common Man; Your Tech-friendly bank
Where service is a way of life

blocks.title: The two ‘Good people’ taglines
blocks.text: Indian Overseas Bank says Good people to **grow** with. Union Bank of India says Good people to **bank** with. Exams love swapping the last word.

blocks.title: Good people: grow or bank?
blocks.phrase: Overseas people GROW abroad (IOB); a Union is where people BANK together (Union Bank).
blocks.note: Swap the last words and you lose the mark: IOB grows, Union banks.

blocks.title: Tagline word-hooks
blocks.phrase: Tech = Indian Bank; Trust = UCO (honours) and PNB (name you can bank upon); Family = Maharashtra; International = Baroda; Central says its year.
letters: Bank of Maharashtra (One Family One Bank)
Central Bank of India (Central to you since 1911)

sections.title: When were the public sector banks established?

blocks.title: From oldest to newest
items: **Punjab National Bank**: incorporated in 1894, started business in 1895.
**State Bank of India** (as the State Bank, successor to the Imperial Bank).

blocks.title: Canara Bank’s birthplace
blocks.text: Canara Bank was first set up in 1906 at Mangalore, even though its headquarters is now in Bengaluru.

blocks.title: Six, seven, eight
blocks.phrase: Six: Bank of India and Canara; Seven: Indian Bank; Eight: Baroda and Punjab & Sind.
letters: Bank of Baroda, Punjab & Sind Bank
blocks.note: Then 1911 Central, 1919 Union, 1935 Maharashtra, 1937 IOB, 1943 UCO, 1955 SBI.

sections.title: Private and foreign banks: taglines and headquarters

blocks.title: Private and foreign banks asked in exams
Headquarters only
rows: Karur (Tamil Nadu); it has since merged with DBS Bank India

blocks.title: Kerala trio
blocks.text: South Indian Bank and Dhanlaxmi Bank are both in Thrissur; Federal Bank is in Aluva. All three are in Kerala.

blocks.title: Where are the south Indian private banks?
blocks.phrase: Karur has two (KVB and Lakshmi Vilas), Kerala has three (Federal, SIB, Dhanlaxmi), Karnataka Bank is in Mangaluru.
letters: Karur Vysya Bank, Lakshmi Vilas Bank
blocks.note: Hint: ‘K’ banks KVB and Lakshmi Vilas share Karur; ‘Karnataka Bank’ is the Mangaluru one.

rows: Bank for central banks; offices in Hong Kong and Mexico City

Added to the Second Schedule of the RBI Act, 1934
Serves the diamond and diamond jewellery sector

blocks.title: The Basel link
blocks.text: BIS = Basel (Switzerland). Basel norms are named after the same city, because the committee meets at the BIS.

blocks.title: International HQs in a line
blocks.phrase: BIS in Basel, AIIB in Beijing, ADB in Manila: B-B, A-B, A-M.
blocks.note: BIS and AIIB both start with a B-sound city (Basel, Beijing); ADB is the odd one, in Manila.

revision: As per the book list there are 12 public sector banks; four have their headquarters in Mumbai: SBI, Bank of India, Central Bank and Union Bank.
Punjab National Bank and Punjab & Sind Bank are both in New Delhi; Indian Bank and Indian Overseas Bank are both in Chennai.
Bank of Baroda is in Vadodara, Bank of Maharashtra in Pune, Canara Bank in Bengaluru and UCO Bank in Kolkata.
SBI: The Nation banks on us. PNB: The Name you can Bank Upon. Baroda: India’s International Bank. BoI: Relationship beyond Banking.
Bank of Maharashtra: One Family One Bank. Canara: Together We Can. Central: Central to you since 1911.
Indian Bank: Taking Banking Technology to Common Man; Your Tech-friendly bank. UCO Bank: Honours Your Trust.
IOB: Good people to grow with. Union Bank: Good people to bank with. Punjab & Sind: Where service is a way of life.
Establishment years: BoI and Canara 1906, Indian Bank 1907, BoB and P&S 1908, Central 1911, Union 1919, BoM 1935, IOB 1937, UCO 1943, SBI 1955.
Bank of India’s logo has a star; Canara Bank was first set up at Mangalore in 1906.
HDFC Bank: We understand your world; ICICI Bank: Hum Hai Na; HSBC: The world’s local bank.
J&K Bank: Serving to Empower; Dhanlaxmi Bank: Tann. Mann. Dhan; Karur Vysya Bank: Smart way to Bank with.
Karnataka Bank is at Mangaluru; South Indian Bank at Thrissur; Federal Bank at Aluva; Karur Vysya and Lakshmi Vilas at Karur.
BIS is at Basel, AIIB at Beijing, ADB at Manila (Philippines), NongHyup Bank at Seoul, Antwerp Diamond Bank at Antwerp.
NSDL Payments Bank is headquartered in Maharashtra.
